experimental_design: comparison of urine proteins between sexes (male vs female) and hormonal conditions (sham-operated, castrated, and testosterone-treated)
MUP levels were significantly decreased by castration but restored by T treatment
factor_value: sex (male, female), hormonal status (sham-operated control, castrated, T treatment)
males had approximately ten-fold higher concentrations of total urine protein than females
number_of_fractions: We excised each of the three predominant bands from an IEF gel
number_of_samples: Mass spectrometric analysis identified the three proteins as MUP13, alpha-2u globulin PGCL2 and odorant-binding protein 3 (OBP3)
